# FG-REPO-0010

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 409 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `removing_the_last_owner_is_refused_under_concurrency` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: メンバーの変更が、今のメンバーの状態と合いません。画面を更新して確認してください。
- en: The membership change does not fit the current members. Refresh and check.
- id: Perubahan anggota tidak sesuai dengan keadaan anggota saat ini. Muat ulang dan periksa.

## 原因 (cause)

A group or project membership change conflicts with the current members: the user is already a member, is not a member, would remove or demote the last direct active Owner of a top-level group, would remove or demote the last direct Owner of a project that has no inherited active Owner (an ancestor group's direct Owner or the owner of the personal namespace the project is in; D4 MR4), or no longer has the direct role the caller authorized against (`role_changed`: change_member / remove_member take that role as `from` and re-read it under the lock, so a promotion committed between authorize() and the change is not overridden; D4 review), or is a bot (bots act for a person and are never members, ADR-0017; also when a bot is named as the first Owner of a new group or as the creator of a new project, or a project is to be created in a bot's personal namespace, whose owner would inherit Owner). The last-owner rule holds against member changes and concurrent disables of the other owners. Disabling the sole active Owner of a top-level group, or the only active Owner (direct or inherited) of a project, is refused by users::disable with FG-AUTH-0009 `last_owner` (steps D3, D4 MR4); disabling the ancestor owners a subgroup relies on is not refused (subgroups may be left to inherit).

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `reason` (already_member, not_member, last_owner, bot_member, role_changed with `expected` and `actual`, the authorized and the stored direct role) and `action`; ids only, no names. For last_owner, the event also carries `group_id` (a group) or `project_id` (a project); list that group's direct owners with a privileged query on forge.group_members joined to forge.users (state = 'active'): a top-level group needs at least one; a subgroup relies on its ancestors' owners. A project needs one active Owner among its direct owners (forge.project_members role = 'owner'), its ancestor groups' direct owners and the owner of its personal parent namespace.

## 対処 (fix)

Refresh and retry (for role_changed, reload the member's role and authorize again); for last_owner, first make another active user an Owner of the group or project.
